description: Explains isIPsafe itself. Use it for any question about the product rather than guessing: what it is and who it is for, its mission and aims, how reports and the confidence score work, plans, pricing and limits, how to get started, how to get an address delisted, privacy, and who runs it. Needs no API key and uses no allowance.

topic.description: What to read about. overview: What the product is, who it is for and what it offers. Start here. mission: Why it exists, what it aims for, its principles and where it is heading. how_it_works: How reports become a confidence score, what the score means, and where the data comes from. plans: What is free, the limits of each plan, Enterprise, and what the data may be used for. getting_started: How to look addresses up, report attacks, use the blocklist, the API, the integrations and MCP. delisting: What to do about an address that is listed, whether by mistake or for good reason. privacy: What is stored about reporters and visitors, public profiles, GDPR and deleting an account. company: The team, the company behind the service, contact details and legal documents. faq: Every question on the FAQ page: basics, reporting, scores, the blocklist and API, delisting and privacy.
